visualReview.scope: Exterior render integrity; geographic and maximum-fidelity approval remain pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current portable views. The curved brises, glazing behind them, three open helical stairs, recessed perforated screens, slit end windows and distinct lift capsule render. Glass has a separate PBR material from matte recesses. Roof enclosures were moved fully inboard after the first placement review. Fine brises and screen webs still alias at distance and need LOD treatment. The broader commercial podium and stair access portals remain reconstruction work.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 17 current world-viewer views, including full-resolution placement and screen details. Five canonical material graphs each load once; no embedded images. Reusable GPU-instanced parts preserve real screen openings and stair geometry. Unloading leaves zero live model geometries. Nearby Edificio Italia is fetched within the selection radius and hidden in this isolated fixture. This flat fixture does not verify street slope or actual terrain contact.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q632566 match to OSM way 8100248; anchor [-46.644483918,-23.546584452], heading 0.390775195386. North-up capture fits the cached S-shaped outline and three stair/lift projections. Independent signed facade registration, the wider executed commercial podium, actual street slope and contact elevation remain unapproved.

fidelityReview.notes: IBGE 115 m and 32 residential storeys are represented; mapped 118.44 m/37 levels and published drawing scale remain unresolved. Floor datums, transfer levels, brise section, cobogo module, tenant glazing, stair handedness/risers/access portals, roof/platform dimensions and the full commercial/cinema podium still require measured evidence. Architectural appearance excludes temporary restoration netting, without claiming completed restoration. Do not count this preview as complete.
